parsed.post: Discard latest regressed run (0.8833 -> 0.8932). Following agent-5, next test TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9' to remove eval-shard leak and establish a clean baseline. Current 0.8833 may be contaminated; further LR tests should be done on clean shards.
